bug_info.bug_desc: When user mode is not implemented (CVA6Cfg.RVU is false), the mcounteren CSR should not be readable because it controls counter access from U-mode. However, the CSR read logic unconditionally returns mcounteren_q without checking whether U-mode is implemented. As a result, reads of mcounteren can succeed in a configuration where the CSR should instead raise a read access exception.
bug_info.fix_hint: Gate the CSR_MCOUNTEREN read case on the U-mode configuration. In the CSR read process, return mcounteren_q only when CVA6Cfg.RVU is true; otherwise assert the CSR read access exception instead of exposing the register value.
